description: PDT 2 phase 0 (P2-K-01, srad/agentspaces-pdt2.md §3.6): negentropy v1 conformance vectors, every message of every round as the reference implementation writes it, for the store reconciliation that TREE_WANT.sketch and TREE_END.sketch carry. Generated by agentspaces/tools/negentropy/negentropy-vectors.cjs; do not edit by hand.
crossCheck: messages recorded from the upstream reference implementation itself; no upstream static vector file exists (its suite diffs ports live through test/harness), so phase 5 also runs each port in the upstream harness

protocol.fingerprint: the first 16 bytes of sha-256 over (the sum of the ids mod 2^256, each a 32-byte little-endian integer) followed by the varint count
protocol.frameSizeLimit: 0 for none, else at least 4096; a message stops 200 bytes short of it
protocol.infinityTimestamp: encoded as 0; other timestamps as 1 + the offset from the previous bound in the message
protocol.timestampUnit: epoch seconds: the reference implementation codes varints with 32-bit operators and never reconciles a timestamp of 2^31 or more, so these vectors cannot use the epoch milliseconds of srad/agentspaces-pdt2.md §3.6 (an open item for phase 5)

recipe.id: sha-256 over the UTF-8 text "aspace:negentropy:<universe>:<i>", as hex
recipe.sets: client and server name half-open ranges [from, to) of item indexes in their universe
recipe.roles: the client initiates; each server reply goes back to the client, which accumulates have (ids it holds that the server lacks) and need (ids the server holds that it lacks) until its reconcile returns null
